reviews.title: Keep getting an error
reviews.text: I just downloaded the game onto my iPad mini 4 and I’ve been trying to play the game, but it keeps coming up with an error part of the way through the update/load process

reviews.title: App crashing
reviews.text: I’ve played for about a year and now it crashes every time I open it. Been down for over 24 hours. Tried to soft restart phone and reinstall. Still crashing

reviews.title: Great
reviews.text: Im addicted to this game. The only thing that I don’t like about it is that I only get 100 energy and then I have to start spending my diamonds and watching ads for energy. I can’t accumulate more than 20 diamonds at a time because I always spend them on energy which sucks because now there aren’t enough diamonds to spend on anything else. But other than the energy and diamond amount I really enjoy playing this game. As I said before I’m addicted!

reviews.title: Great Game!
reviews.text: I am normally not one for merge games, because I find them so boring. I can’t say that about this merge game. For starters, it has a great story to follow while playing the game and that keeps it very entertaining. In general, the game is fun, easy, and relaxing. 5 star ⭐️ game all around.

reviews.title: Stingy on the rewards and prizes. Even when you win a prize, you have to wait two hours to open it.
reviews.text: It’s not a fun game to play because there’s so stingy on the energy and you have to match things 100 times to get one thing to get a prize and then you have to wait two hours it’s not fun.

reviews.title: Game issues
reviews.text: I just installed this game today and i am having issues with game play. I am on level 12, the game is telling me to tap on the earth icon but it’s not accepting my taps. So I can’t move forward.

reviews.title: Update
reviews.text: The game has completely change from the characters and the story with the update. I download this game because I enjoy the original characters and storyline

reviews.title: Lost progress.
reviews.text: I updated and lost most of my progress.

reviews.title: Game completely changed
reviews.text: What happened? The game has completely changed with the last update.

reviews.title: Tutorial
reviews.text: Get rid of the annoying finger pointing what you want done next.

reviews.title: Not great
reviews.text: Energy runs out too fast can’t merge a lot of items to get what you need. Can only play one a day for 5 min unless you spend money for more energy. It’s a nice game just wish the energy wasn’t so little and gone before you can even merge an item you need. Ads are too long as well for free energy makes me not even want it and it’s not even much at all. So much potential

reviews.title: Good, but
reviews.text: I enjoy the game, but there are some glitches. The game updated which changed some of the items that can be merged. However, the game did not update the existing goals, so I have some orders that I can never complete because the item no longer exists. Also, the game doesn’t always save my progress. So I have to earn twice as much to redo my previously made renovations.

reviews.title: Repeating levels for no reason
reviews.text: I’m feeling really frustrated because I’ve had to repeat the same spaces for no reason. Yesterday when I was playing, I was doing the kitchen. Today when I started playing, I was back in the theater room. This has happened 4x and I’m getting ready to quit the game.

reviews.title: Fun Game

reviews.title: Great  game
reviews.text: The only thing that is wrong with this came is that iPad has to be vertical ,I prefer to hold my iPad horizontal

reviews.title: Glitches
reviews.text: There are glitches in the game not allowing me to sell items if it’s not needed.

reviews.title: Some things are frustrating
reviews.text: There’s some events like I think it’s called legacy of corsairs or something. I wish it gave you the option to exit out of the event when you don’t want to join it because it’s not a good time but no it does not give you the option and then it starts counting down on a timer.. they really should fix this because people should have the option to start that event when they are ready not just when they are trying to look around and do something else

reviews.title: Games fun
reviews.text: Don’t fall for the 400 energy for inviting someone that reaches lvl 6.  I know for a fact I had 2 people reach it and didn’t see credit for either.  Messaged then about it. Got a run around about hugs being fixed yet never got my credit of 800 energy.

reviews.title: Great game, recent update causing problems
reviews.text: As the title states, this is an amazing game. With the recent update the Professional Craft Table won’t give me necessary items and (even more concerning) has the option to sell it. The majority of items in my cue NEEDS items from this object and I can’t really move on with the game until it’s fixed

reviews.title: Unable to display normally
reviews.text: When using gold coins to buy furniture in the game, the normal page cannot be displayed normally, the next step cannot be carried out, and there is no way to continue the game. Please deal with it in time. Thank you.

reviews.title: Great game but needs to fix issues
reviews.text: I love the game concept and you win extra energy all the time to be able to play for a long time. The only issue I’m having is I can’t buy a fridge cause the choices are cut off the screen. This makes it where i can’t complete the area and move on to other rooms. I have contacted support through the app and on the developer website with no luck. If they don’t fix this bug soon, you will be stuck fairly quick in the game.

reviews.title: Stuck
reviews.text: I am stuck on the kitchen scene. I can't buy refrigerator because the screen is cut off!!! I can't get any further!! I have contacted support but no one HAS responded!!

reviews.text: Several problems…in the merge area to start with there’s not enough space. Have to keep putting stuff in your storage. And when your decorating it doesn’t deduct money. That’s fine but where’s the fun in that.
